title: Titanium Cassette Cog
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Cassette Cog because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Lightweight cassette sprocket cog. This rationale is driven by lightweight cassette sprocket cog and service environment demands.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for drivetrain hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g at 200W fiber laser
Go/No-Go ring gauging at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for lightweight cassette sprocket application
commonFailures: Bearing race brinelling from over-torque - avoided by torque-limiting press-fit tool with ±2% accuracy — critical for lightweight cassette sprocket performance

faq.q: Does Titanium Cassette Cog require special assembly or anti-seize?
faq.a: Yes. Titanium-to-titanium threaded interfaces on Titanium Cassette Cog are susceptible to galling (cold welding) during assembly. Application of MoS₂ or copper-based anti-seize compound to all threaded contact surfaces is mandatory. Lubricated installation torque values are typically 15-20% lower than dry values. Thread engagement should not exceed 3× thread diameter.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Cassette Cog orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Cassette Cog is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Cassette Cog?
faq.a: Each Titanium Cassette Cog shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for lightweight cassette sprocket.

Forged and CNC machined from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V, it achieves 40-45% weight savings versus steel while maintaining the fatigue life required for demanding cycling applications.
